item.title: CyberPulse — Short Windows, Wide Blast Radius (2026-10-19)
item.dc:creator: Tushar Vartak
item.description: Remote gateways and mail infrastructure face live exploitation, multiple gateway vendors ship critical fixes, a maximum-severity plugin flaw enables unauthenticated code execution, and the monthly platform bundle raises patch pressure. P0: pull admin planes off the internet and patch the edge. P1: revoke sessions and cut token lifetimes. P2: treat plugin governance as production security and update client libraries.
